title: The three San Francisco homes in the case, 2023 to 2025, from their own reports
question: How did the amount owed to the San Francisco homes by their related companies grow, set against what the homes earned?
finding: Central Gardens Post Acute: $10.7 million owed in 2023, $18.1 million in 2025 (net income over the years $9.1 million); San Francisco Post Acute: $16.9 million owed in 2023, $25.0 million in 2025 (net income over the years $10.3 million); Victorian Post Acute: $12.6 million owed in 2023, $20.2 million in 2025 (net income over the years $8.9 million).
how: Each home's facsimile report for 2023, 2024 and 2025 (as submitted for 2024 and 2025 at San Francisco Post Acute and for 2025 at all three; audited where the State has finished). Figures from pages 5.1, 5.2, 8, 3.3 (home-office cost allocations) and 10.4.
limits: The rise tracks the profit each year, which is what daily cash pooling into a group account produces. The reports do not say whether the balance carries interest or is ever repaid; the group's own accounts would.
